review_candidates.description: EnerSys is a global leader in stored energy solutions for industrial applications. We have over thirty manufacturing and assembly plants worldwide servicing over 10,000 customers in more than 100 countries. Worldwide headquarters are located in Reading, PA, USA with regional headquarters in Europe and Asia. The company designs, manufacturers and qualifies batteries for international space missions on satellites, launchers, and interplanetary vehicles. The company’s customers include both national and international space agencies like NASA and European Space Agency as well as working across the commercial market supporting missions that include Earth observation, internet of things satellite constellations and global positioning systems. The position is based in the Culham Science Centre near Abingdon in Oxfordshire and is a job that can truly impact people across the globe. Our EMEA Defence business unit supplies Hawker batteries into military vehicle applications. We have sold over four million Hawker ARMASAFE 6T/AGM batteries into this sector over the years for over forty allied nations. EnerSys’ unique Thin Plate Pure Lead (TPPL), VRLA, AGM design is the foundation of this success providing clear operational advantages and total cost of ownership benefits. Regularly visit and communicate with customers to understand their technical and commercial needs, building long-term relationships. Organize and support customer visits to plants with local plant representatives. Develop relationships with end users to improve operational feedback. Contribute to and develop sales pipelines. Capture market intelligence to update customer/prospect stakeholder mapping data. Develop and present sales material; deliver product demonstrations for batteries and battery management systems. Collaborate with the marketing team to understand market trends and competitor activity. Have thorough knowledge of customer tender/procurement processes and decision makers. Maintain up-to-date knowledge of battery and power management technology. Produce professional and tailored offers maximizing value for EnerSys and the customer. Manage pricing attentively to maintain margin; work with or manage price lists as appropriate. Collaborate with local country sales teams, shared service centre, and manufacturing plants to prepare offers, process orders, and ensure customer deliveries meet expectations. Conduct contract review activities with manufacturing plants where appropriate. Ensure compliance with export licenses and other regulatory requirements. Support and engage in warranty claims. Participate in regular forecasting, planning, and reporting activities, including CRM usage. Work with marketing to identify and nurture prospects and business development opportunities Qualifications Strong sales experience with a demonstrable track record. Relevant electrical/electronics engineering or science qualification, or equivalent experience. Experience in the defense sector, Ministry of Defence, and/or OEM. Excellent written and oral communication skills. Credible, confident, and compelling presentation skills. Ability to work independently and as part of a team. Willingness to learn and develop new ideas contributing to business growth. Driving license. Job Requirements Essential: Willingness to undertake considerable lone travel throughout Europe. Work from home with travel; occasional visits to the office or plant required. Ability to work seamlessly with a team, showing trustworthiness, flexibility, and adaptability. Desirable: Ability to speak/write in Polish, French, or German. Knowledge of armoured vehicles, particularly electrical power systems. Knowledge of battery technologies, battery monitoring/management, and related technology. Prior operational experience in the military. Key account management experience. CRM experience. review_candidates.description: Position Overview A detail-oriented and proactive Quality Assurance Assistant is sought to support quality and food safety standards within a food manufacturing environment. Reporting to the Quality Assurance Manager, the role involves working closely with production teams to ensure products and manufacturing processes consistently meet established quality requirements. Key Responsibilities The selected candidate will carry out production line start-up checks, sample and measure products during production, and verify that finished products conform to established specifications and quality standards. The role includes monitoring Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), ensuring procedures are correctly followed, and performing basic analytical tests, with relevant in-house training provided. Responsibilities also involve verifying compliance with HACCP requirements and supporting the effective implementation of food safety and quality procedures throughout production operations. Requirements Candidates should have a minimum O-Level standard of education , with preference given to applicants who have studied Chemistry, Biology, Food Science, or related subjects. Good analytical and problem-solving abilities, computer literacy including Microsoft Office, effective communication skills, and strong attention to detail are required. The ideal candidate should be a reliable team player who can also work independently, demonstrate initiative, and remain flexible according to production requirements. A valid Food Handlers Licence B is required. Candidates must also be flexible regarding working hours, as production line start-up checks may occasionally require shifts beginning as early as 4:00 a.m. Career Opportunity This position offers valuable hands-on experience in food quality assurance, GMP, HACCP, product testing, and manufacturing quality control while providing an opportunity to develop technical knowledge and experience within the food production industry.

review_candidates.title: Program Associate-City Resilience - Cooling
review_candidates.company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
review_candidates.description: Programme Associate – City Resilience - Cooling (1) The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is looking for a Programme Associate for the Cooling and Refrigeration Programme. This is a mid-level research and analyst position requiring 5+ years of relevant work experience. The successful applicant should possess strong technical knowledge of cooling and refrigeration systems , complemented by policy and stakeholder engagement experience. Prior experience in Lifecycle Refrigerant Management (LRM) , natural refrigerants , sustainable cooling , and centralised or district cooling , and international policies like the Kigali Amendment is desirable. Position is based in Noida/ Delhi NCR About the Programme Cooling and Refrigeration is a part of iFOREST's flagship initiative on Enhancing Resilience for Sustainable Development. The objective of the programme is to accelerate the adoption of sustainable cooling solutions and strengthen lifecycle refrigerant management to improve energy efficiency and promote circular economy practices in the cooling sector. The programme is strongly focused on policy and technical research, stakeholder engagement, and implementation support, particularly with government departments, industry, development partners, and international organisations to enable India's low-carbon cooling transition. Qualification & Work Experience Bachelor's or Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering and/or a related engineering discipline with a focus on cooling technologies and sustainable cooling . Candidates must have prior experience in at least some of the following : Lifecycle Refrigerant Management (LRM), refrigeration and air conditioning (RAC), sustainable cooling technologies, natural refrigerants, centralised/district cooling or cooling sector decarbonisation strategies. Candidates with prior experience working with government agencies, industry, international organisations, or development partners on cooling and refrigeration initiatives are desirable. A minimum of 5 years of relevant work experience in industry is required. Competencies & Responsibilities The successful candidate should have the following competencies: Strong technical knowledge of air conditioning and refrigeration (RAC) systems, including heat load calculations, cooling demand assessment, refrigerant technologies, system performance analysis, energy efficiency, and sustainable cooling solutions. Strong research skills with the ability to work with large datasets, quantitative analysis and high-quality technical report writing. Strong engagement skills to engage with industry partners and government agencies The key job responsibilities of the Programme Associate will be the following: Develop research methodologies, undertake technical research related to Lifecycle Refrigerant Management (LRM), refrigeration and air conditioning (RAC), sustainable cooling technologies, natural refrigerants, and centralised/district cooling. Conduct primary survey, field visits related to cooling and refrigeration systems, as required for the project. Prepare high-quality technical reports, briefs, etc. Coordinate with government agencies to procure necessary information for research. Co-ordinate with industries and industry associations regarding research, and to identify practical solutions for scaling up action on sustainable cooling. Do meetings and presentations to stakeholders to disseminate research findings and build their engagement. Convene stakeholder meetings/workshops. Stay updated with ongoing sustainable cooling research, cooling technologies, regulations and policies. Any other related assignments as may be entrusted by the reporting authority. Why Choose iFOREST Purpose-driven work : Contributing to sub-national, national, and global goals. Professional development : In areas and sectors that are contemporary and pressing. Compensation : We offer a salary that is not only competitive but recognises and rewards your commitment and talent. Inclusive Culture : Benefit from a supportive and diverse work environment. Remuneration Competitive salary as per candidate’s experience and proficiency. Final designation of successful candidate will be based on qualification and experience. Application deadline & instructions: Immediate opening. Position open until filled. We prefer the candidate to submit an online application at:- https://forms.gle/vVWXucPavwsaDRtAA. You can In case of any difficulty, you may also send your application to contact@iforest.global . A CV and a Cover Letter must accompany applications. Please ensure that the Cover Letter is no more than 500 words and clearly describes your suitability for the described position and the motivation to join iFOREST. Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

We are the fastest-growing B2B SaaS in the industry, trusted by 4,000+ clients across 40+ countries , with billions of euros in bookings processed. Backed by top international investors and named one of Italy's Top 10 LinkedIn Startups, we are on a mission to scale globally. Want to grow with us? Let's go! About The Role What Will You Do? 🦾 As a true product owner with a founder’s DNA , you’ll be responsible for ideating, validating, and driving new products to success — like running your own startup, but with the power of an established growth engine behind you. Your Missions Spot opportunities & validate ideas through research, interviews, and fast MVPs. Run lean experiments with landing pages, prototypes, and no-code tools. Lead cross-functional squads (Product, Tech, Marketing, Sales) like an internal startup. Own go-to-market & early adoption, from positioning to first deals. Track KPIs & pivot fast, turning insights into growth. Drive end-to-end execution, taking products from 0 to MVP to initial traction. Product Execution – Experienced in problem validation, rapid MVP building (incl. no-code), clear roadmaps, and data-driven decisions. Track Record – 3+ years in startups or scale-ups, 2–3 years in GTM-heavy or founder-like roles, proven success taking products from 0 to 1. Bonus – Background in Hospitality Tech, HR Tech, or Fintech. Languages – Fluent English + Professional Italian. What Do We Offer? 👌 Work in a small and top-performing team that moves extremely fast where you are extremely important. Work without having to deal with jerks and ego-maniacs. The opportunity to join one of the best travel-tech sales teams in Europe. A place where your talent can blossom. An environment where mistakes are allowed – we make bold choices to achieve ambitious goals, learn from mistakes, and move forward. A place where your voice matters – meetings provide space for new ideas and projects, regardless of your role or seniority. Continuous growth – we challenge the status quo, renewing our sales processes and approaches to meet challenging goals. We have fun while working! We are easygoing people. Work with the best software out there to automate repetitive tasks and let you focus on customers and targets. Remote working. Our compensation philosophy is designed to reward growth, ownership, and meaningful contributions. As you develop your skills and increase your impact within the company, your compensation can progress rapidly to reflect your achievements and responsibilities. For exceptional candidates demonstrating outstanding potential or experience, we may consider offers beyond the standard compensation ranges. Still not convinced? Every day, we step out of our comfort zones, fueling rapid growth and learning, even though it might come with its stress. If you believe it is, we warmly invite you to apply. Discover your full potential with us!
